description.value:
Frequency once per day

Duration 1 minute

Draw a quick ward in blood, ash, or ink on a nearby surface. While within 10 feet of it, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against effects created by fiends, undead, or aberrations. The ward crumbles if moved and does not travel with you.

cinderfall.incomplete: Genuine engine limit, not a missing companion Effect: the ward is a fixed point in space ("draw a ward on a nearby surface... crumbles if moved, does not travel with you"), not bound to any actor. Checked real pf2e's closest analog, the Champion's Protective Wards (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/spell-effects/aura-protective-wards.json) -- its Aura rule element is anchored to the CASTER, moving with them, same as every other Aura in pf2e-source. There is no fixed-point-anchor mechanism in pf2e's rule-element vocabulary; a ward that stays behind when you leave would need a Foundry scene object (wall/region/light), well outside card JSON authoring.
